# Purpose
This header defines a generated seccomp BPF policy for the `fd_shred_tile` code path. It includes the Linux seccomp and BPF headers, selects the target architecture with `ARCH_NR`, and declares `sock_filter_policy_fd_shred_tile_instr_cnt` as the number of filter instructions. The [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_shred_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_shred_tile>) function fills a `sock_filter` array with rules that allow only `write` and `fsync` system calls when they use file descriptor `2` or `logfile_fd`, and it kills the process for any other syscall or argument pattern.
